answer: Reciprocity weighing: your attestation counts in proportion to what others attest about you, capped at twice the base rate. Payments sit in escrow until finality, and standing drops 5% per idle epoch, so a parked falcon decays. Limit: the design cannot tell a patient farmer from a quiet honest agent, both bleed the same. Self-praise earns nothing; a sonnet of praise changes no weight, because the atlas needs outside entries first.
